Built for you

tools your tutor designed for what you need

Which trust fits?

Revocable keeps control and avoids probate; irrevocable moves assets out of the estate and protects them.

Which business entity fits?

Pick the entity by owner count, liability protection and how the business is taxed.

Is a traditional IRA contribution deductible?

Deductibility depends on whether you or a spouse has a workplace plan and on your income.

Roth IRA: direct, backdoor or none?

Income decides whether you can contribute directly, need a backdoor route, or cannot contribute.

When should Social Security be claimed?

Weigh a larger lifetime benefit against needing the income sooner, health and marital status.

Which college funding choice fits?

Match the funding vehicle to the goal, the tax treatment and who controls the money.

Your HP 10bII+

keystrokes, checked against HP's guide
Walk it on the keypad
Before every problemOrange Shift, C clears everything. Then set P/YR to match the problem: 12 Shift PMT (P/YR) for monthly, 4 quarterly, 2 semiannual, 1 yearly. The factory setting is 12. With P/YR set, I/YR is always the annual rate, and N is the years then Shift N (xP/YR), which multiplies by P/YR. Shift MAR (BEG/END) toggles BEGIN, which shows on screen. Leave it off unless payments come at the start of the period.
Time valueType a value, press its key: N, I/YR, PV, PMT, FV. There is no compute key; with four filled in, press the fifth to solve. Money you pay out is negative.
Cash flows, NPV, IRRClear, set P/YR to 1. Time 0 first: amount, CFj (outlay negative). A flow that repeats: type the count, then Shift CFj (Nj). NPV: rate, I/YR, then Shift PRC (NPV). IRR: Shift CST (IRR/YR), no rate needed.
Nominal to effective rate10 Shift I/YR (NOM%), 12 Shift PMT (P/YR), Shift PV (EFF%) gives 10.47. Reset P/YR to 1 afterwards.
Loan balance and interestSolve the payment first, with P/YR matching the payment frequency. Then 1 INPUT 12 Shift FV (AMORT) shows payments 1 to 12. Press = to step through principal, interest, then balance.
Powers and reciprocalsShift × is yˣ, Shift ÷ is 1/x, Shift − is √x, Shift 1 is eˣ, Shift 2 is LN.

Pacing

about two minutes a question

Case-study playbook

from prep courses and passers
Questions firstSkim the questions to spot the theme (tax, retirement, insurance), then skim the facts. Some questions need none of them.
Skip the fillerFlag key details; don't crunch every number on the first pass. Many are filler.
Read footnotesExhibits and footnotes often hold the one fact the answer turns on.
Odd figuresAn oddly precise number or loan term usually signals a calculation, such as $1,019,000 = a $1,000,000 gift plus the $19,000 exclusion.
Name the domainDecide which area the question tests, then pick the answer that belongs there. A new client calls for fact-finding, not recommendations.
Stuck? 60 to 90 secondsPick your best answer, flag it, move on. There is no penalty for guessing. Finish a case before a break, since you can't go back.
Exception to the exceptionMany right answers hinge on an exception to a rule, so before you pick the rule, ask what would change it.
First 30 secondsBefore question 1, write your acronyms, tricky numbers and phase-outs on the scratch paper. Then you can stop holding them in your head.
Pace checkpointsGlance at the clock at questions 25, 50 and 75 of each section, not more often. Behind, speed up a little. Ahead, don't rush.

Exam format

source: cfp.net
Total questions170 multiple-choice, in stand-alone items, short scenarios, and longer case histories.
StructureTwo 3-hour sections, each split into two subsections (43 + 42 questions), for four subsections total.
TimingEach 3-hour section has one shared, pooled timer across its two subsections — unused time doesn't carry to the next section.
BreaksOne optional break after the first subsection of each section, plus a scheduled 40-minute break between the two sections that you can skip. The clock keeps running during the optional breaks.
No going backOnce you submit a subsection, you cannot return to it — including after the 40-minute break.
Check-in securityExpect a fingerprint scan and photo capture at check-in, repeated every time you leave and re-enter the room (including after breaks), plus a pocket check and a security wand scan.
ResultsPrometric emails a preliminary result shortly after the exam. Official results follow by email, typically four to six weeks after the testing window closes.
Tax law testedExams in the July 2026, October 2026 and March 2027 windows test 2026 tax law, so use the 2026 figures in this app. The October 2026 window runs October 29 to November 5.
Appointment lengthThe appointment is 7 hours, including 6 hours of testing, plus a 2-minute nondisclosure agreement, a 5-minute tutorial and a 5-minute survey. Clear your calculator's memory before each section; the proctor will not do it for you.
Pass rateRecent administrations have landed in the mid-60s (November 2025 was 64%, per CFP Board); first-time takers pass at a noticeably higher rate than repeaters.

After you start

source: cfp.net
FinishingIf time is left after your last answer, you can review only the final subsection (2b). Submitting early is final. After a short survey your preliminary result shows on screen, and Prometric emails a copy. To skip the 40-minute break, choose "Resume Test".
Check-in detailsThe name on your ID must match your registration; a common nickname (Catherine for Cathy) is acceptable. Your calculator is inspected, and any notes or formulas on it must be covered with solid-color tape. Noise-cancelling headphones are available on request, and soft ear plugs without wires are allowed.
Official practice examYour registration includes one CFP Board Practice Exam: 170 questions, with retired real questions, and results by domain. Take it as a rehearsal under timed conditions, and use the by-domain result to point your last days of study.
On-screen toolsAn on-screen clock, text highlighting, a mark-for-review flag, and the exam's formula sheet and tax tables are available while you test. Scratch paper and pencils are supplied and collected at the end.
ReschedulingWithin the same window it is free 61 or more days ahead, $35 at 31 to 60 days, $100 at 5 to 30 days, and not allowed in the last 5 days. A no-show forfeits the fee.
Retakes and rescoringA retake means the whole exam, in a later window. The limits are three attempts in any 24 months and five in a lifetime. Check CFP Board's current policy if you want to question a result, but a change from fail to pass is highly unlikely.
If you don't passYou'll receive a diagnostic report showing your performance across the Principal Knowledge Topics to help target a retake.

Calculator policy

source: cfp.net

You must bring your own battery-powered, non-programmable, dedicated financial calculator. CFP Board does not provide one.

Your calculator: HP 10bII+

The full list of approved models is on cfp.net.

You clear your calculator's memory yourself before each section (staff inspect it first, but don't clear it for you), then reset your settings. On the HP 10bII+ that means checking P/YR (the default is 12) and END mode. Cover any printed formulas or notes on the calculator with solid tape.

Exam-week checklist

What to bring

source: cfp.net
ArrivalPlan to begin check-in 30 minutes before your scheduled time. Arriving late means being turned away and forfeiting the exam fee entirely — there's no grace period.
RequiredValid, unexpired government-issued photo ID matching your registration name.
CalculatorYour HP 10bII+. A backup is allowed if it is also on the approved list at cfp.net.
WaterOne clear bottle with all labels removed is allowed in the exam room.
Food & notesNot allowed in the exam room, but you may store them in your locker to use during the scheduled 40-minute break.
ElectronicsNo phones, smartwatches, or other electronic devices are accessible once testing begins — they stay locked away until you finish.

Backup & restore

Progress is saved to this browser automatically, but that save isn't fully reliable in every environment — even a page refresh can occasionally lose it, not just an update to this app. The only guaranteed-safe copy is one you export yourself. Download a backup regularly, especially before refreshing or closing the app.

A backup file just downloaded automatically to your device (this doesn't depend on this app's storage at all, so it survives no matter what). Need another copy?
Or select all the text below and copy it somewhere safe (notes app, email to yourself, etc.):
Have a downloaded backup file? It'll be named something like "cfp-blueprint-backup-2026-08-31-...txt" in your downloads folder — select it here:
Or paste your previously backed-up text below:

Content quality check

Checks everything in your bank, including AI-generated content, for duplicates, lopsided answer choices, malformed entries and TVM problems that don't solve. It checks structure, not factual accuracy. Worth running now and then after a lot of AI-generated content builds up.

Syllabus coverage check

Estimates how many questions cover each of the 70 official CFP Board subtopics and lists the thinnest first. Most questions aren't tagged by subtopic yet, so the counts come from matching key terms and are rough. A low number is a pointer, not proof of a gap.

Reset

Clears all saved progress on this device — mastery stats, session history, missed questions, syllabus checklist, flashcard ratings, AI-generated content, and your tutor conversation. Your exam date and light/dark theme choice are kept. This cannot be undone; back up first if you want to keep a copy.
